scenes.viewerPurpose: Introduce an intimate uncertainty around Kazi's identity; Name the novel and establish the uninvited delivery

scenes.title: A carefully balanced world
scenes.viewerPurpose: Place the household inside successful technological coordination; Give citizens ordinary agency and eccentricity
scenes.composition: Look past the household toward working water and energy systems in Port Nacre. Keep a handmade cup and an unaccepted offer beside the patient, showing room for refusal.

scenes.title: Care has a boundary
scenes.viewerPurpose: Bring care and control into the same home; Introduce conflicting professional and personal perspectives
scenes.composition: Move the care record between the physician's hand and the person it concerns. Arrange the physician, blacksmith and former persuader around one promise; each pauses over a different concern.
